sections.name: Plain answers, then a conversation if you want one.

items.text: Strategic acquirers · Questions
Plain answers, then a conversation if you want one.
Why is the premium the risk outside my industry?

Because the synergy that justifies it depends on customers, contracts and people you have not operated with. The published record puts market extension at the bottom of the deal types for returns. The desk reads the adjacent sector the way an operator in it would.
What does criteria on file ask of me?
Your criteria, confirmed with you each quarter. A dedicated search in one sector is by exception, with scope agreed in writing.
Can corporate development use the desk for one target?
Yes. The evidence on a single target, before the letter is priced, is a separately scoped engagement.
Do you represent the seller as well?
Never on the same transaction. Capital Row acts for one side, under a scope agreed in writing.
What is the first conversation?
Which market you are entering, and the timeline. One business day, read by a person.
